params.message:
The team's assistant gets Gentells links for sources through /mcp

Three tools, source_links, source_keep and source_unkeep, listed only to a team member
whose account is shown to be theirs: marked by the reconcile on its address alone is
not enough, because registering does not confirm one. The Observatory answers them and
decides by the person's role there. Own token, DESK_TOOLS_TOKEN; unset means the tools
are not there. MCP contract 4.1.0, added only.

Portal: Het team kan vanuit een gekoppelde assistent Gentells-links voor bronnen opvragen en bewaren.
